module page_title_length
  purpose: Download a web page and measure the characters in its title.

import std.http as web
import std.regex

public type TitleMissingError
  purpose: The page did not contain a title element.
  has message: Text
end

public function title_character_count(url: Url)
  returns Integer
  or fails with TitleMissingError
  needs network.http
  purpose: Download a web page and return the number of characters in its title element.
  expose as tool
  example: title_character_count(url: Url("https://example.com")) is 7

  let page be web.get(url) otherwise fail
  let title_start be page.index_of("<title>")
  if title_start is less than 0 then
    fail with TitleMissingError(message: "The page has no <title> element.")
  end

  let title_content_start be title_start + 7
  let title_end be page.index_of("</title>")
  if title_end is less than 0 then
    fail with TitleMissingError(message: "The page has no closing </title> tag.")
  end

  if title_end is less than title_content_start then
    fail with TitleMissingError(message: "The page has no valid <title> element.")
  end

  let title_text be page.drop(title_content_start).take(title_end - title_content_start)
  return title_text.length
end

module page_title_length
  purpose: Download a web page and measure the characters in its title element.

import std.http as web
import std.regex as regex

public function title_length(url: Url)
  returns Integer
  or fails with TitleError
  needs network.http
  expose as tool
  purpose: Download a web page and return the number of characters in its title element.
  example: title_length(url: Url("https://example.com")) is 7

  let page be web.get(url) otherwise fail with TitleError(message: "failed to download page")
  let title_match be regex.match(page, raw "<title>(.*?)</title>") otherwise fail with TitleError(message: "page has no title element")
  let title_text be title_match.group(1)
  return title_text.length()
end

public type TitleError
  purpose: An error raised when a page has no title element or cannot be read.
  has message: Text
end

  purpose: Errors when a page title cannot be read.

  let page be web.get(url) otherwise fail
  let title_start be page.index_of("<title>")
  if title_start is not -1 then
    let title_content_start be title_start + 7
    let title_end be page.index_of("</title>")
    if title_end is not -1 and title_end is greater than title_content_start then
      let title_text be page.drop(title_content_start).take(title_end - title_content_start)
      return title_text.length
    otherwise
      fail with TitleError.MissingTitle
    end
  otherwise
    fail with TitleError.MissingTitle
  end
